يقترضون (form VIII)
# يَقْتَرِضُونَ (yaqtariḍūna) /jaq.ta.ri.dˤuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
# يُقْتَرَضُونَ (yuqtaraḍūna) /juq.ta.ra.dˤuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
